published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Beast Mastery with a cat, using Bestial Wrath, Frenzy and Unleashed Fury. Melee weaves between Auto Shots. The pet does about 28% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Bestial Wrath (at 0s and 120s), Rapid Fire, racials, Sapper and potions on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) at -1.5s, recast in its last 3s. The raid's mark is off
Arcane Shot on cooldown, before Aimed Shot, at any mana
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Serpent Sting when it's down, last, at any mana
Melee weave between Auto Shots. Walk in for a main-hand swing with Raptor Strike queued, when the next Auto Shot is 1.2s or less away and no shot comes off cooldown
The cat (1.0s) bites and claws on cooldown. Auto Shot the whole fight
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client says 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143 after a server hotfix (the client says 71).
Uses Aspect of the Hawk rank 5 (90 ranged attack power). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
The pet gets 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power on top of its own 254, plus the hunter's crit and hit (from beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot gets 10% of ranged attack power, and Serpent Sting 3% a tick. Beta logs fit 11% and 3.5%.
Auto Shot keeps firing during casts. Moving cancels its 0.5s wind-up.
Pet consumables are off (Forever pets get no player buffs). They would add 17 DPS.
Intimidation is talented but not cast.
Major Frenzy Potion is 25.7 DPS behind Major Mana Potion at 180s.
Crit per Agility is Classic's level 60 rate (0.0189% per point), from Forever's game files.
Uses a 2.5s bow with Rhok'delar's 44.0 weapon DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 DPS higher with a 15% ammo pouch, or 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as seen on a level 17 pet. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2.5 DPS (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
Assumed: each hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs 0.5 to 2.5 DPS at 180s (0.5 here).
No Scorpid Sting. Balance druids already keep up Insect Swarm, which gives the same 2% hit reduction. Scorpid Sting would replace Serpent Sting and cost about 85 to 100 DPS for nothing.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_bm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark (standards 23, Mark duty assumed), so the raid's debuffs.huntersMark is off. Orc since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
